Method of Attack: Exploits CVE-2022-0543 vulnerability in Redis servers
Installs a dropper and establishes P2P communication
Deploys additional binaries, scripts, and scanning tools to propagate the worm
Drops a PowerShell script to maintain communication with the P2P network and modifies the local firewall to block legitimate access
Attack Vector: Scanning for additional Redis instances and SSH port 22
Indicators of Compromise: Infected Redis instances added to a P2P network
